name: inkonabtv
description: InkonabTV player — web (GitHub Pages) and Android phone/TV app from one codebase

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleFullDebug assemblePlayDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleFullRelease assemblePlayRelease
scripts.aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundlePlayRelease
scripts.release:plus: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleFullRelease && cd .. && node scripts/release-plus.mjs
scripts.apk:hotel: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleHotelRelease
